content.intro: Jagged Arrays is lesson 60 in Strings, Characters, Arrays, and Ranges. Strings and arrays are indexed sequences, but text is encoded and may contain multiple code units per user-perceived character. Check boundaries and avoid unintended copies.
content.why_it_matters: Text and sequence bugs often come from assumptions about length, position, copying, or encoding. This lesson focuses on jagged arrays and shows how to verify the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.
